about: The anchor check's level 0 (tools/gauntlet/report.py; .github/workflows/gauntlet.yml downloads the gauntlet-result artifacts of the two runs named here, kept 90 days; tools/gauntlet/archive.sh keeps every run in ~/fork-data/gauntlet/run-ID, which report.py --archive reads). previous: the last gauntlet, compared with the next one. baseline: the gauntlet the running transfer ratio starts from. adopted: every change adopted after the baseline's commit, with its self-play (SPRT) logistic Elo and ci95, the half-width of its 95% interval. After each gauntlet, set previous to it; add each adopted change. Starting values: docs/research/transfer-testing/report.md, sections 1.1 and 1.2. sprt (bug review T4, 2026-11-11): the adopting SPRT's design (a key of tools/gauntlet/stopbias.py DESIGNS), the stages it played and its nElo at the stop (docs/history/phase-4/sprt-log.md), for report.py's stopping-bias lines; give it for every SPRT-adopted change.
